perf_delta.ingest_network_requests_before: /ingest/array/.../config.js + /ingest/config?ip=0 + /ingest/flags fire during initial JS download (compete on bandwidth)
perf_delta.ingest_network_requests_after: fire only after requestIdleCallback resolves — i.e. after first paint and main bundle execution

behavior_changes.early_event_capture: track() / identify() / register() etc. called before init are now queued in-memory and flushed when posthog.init() resolves — events in the first ~500 ms of page load will still appear in PostHog
behavior_changes.consent_replay: AnalyticsConsent's localStorage('ph_consent') decision is re-applied inside initAnalytics so PostHog respects the user's choice even though opt_in/opt_out_capturing fired before the SDK loaded
behavior_changes.feature_flags: useFeatureFlag's onFeatureFlags subscription is buffered pre-init and resubscribed once PostHog loads — flag values may resolve a few hundred ms later than before
behavior_changes.session_replay: startReplay queued pre-init and decided + started once PostHog loads

expected_user_visible_impact.LCP: improves — fewer bytes competing on main JS chain, fewer /ingest requests competing on bandwidth during initial paint
expected_user_visible_impact.FCP: improves — same reason; especially noticeable on throttled 3G/4G
expected_user_visible_impact.TBT: improves — posthog-js init code no longer parses + runs synchronously on main thread before render
expected_user_visible_impact.analytics_funnels: no event loss expected; first events delayed by ~one idle frame (typically <50ms after first paint)
